title: Best of Northern Japan | Exploring Gems of Hokkaido
highlights: Uncover Hokkaido’s timeless charm, where scenic landscapes, cultural treasures, and local flavors create an unforgettable journey.
Step into Noboribetsu’s otherworldly landscapes, where steaming Hell Valley, bubbling hot springs, and volcanic wonders create a scene straight out of a fantasy.
Soak in Jozankei Onsen’s warm, healing waters, surrounded by lush forests and stunning scenery that changes beautifully with the seasons.
Walk through Furano and Biei’s endless fields of flowers, where rolling hills burst into waves of color, making every view feel like a painting.
Explore Daisetsuzan’s wild beauty, from towering peaks to rushing waterfalls, where untouched nature and breathtaking views make every moment unforgettable.
overview:
Discover the best of Hokkaido with this immersive tour, exploring its stunning landscapes, cultural gems, and natural wonders. Begin in Sapporo with city highlights before venturing to Noboribetsu’s volcanic landscapes and Lake Toya’s serene beauty. Relax in Jozankei Onsen, admire Furano and Biei’s colorful fields, and explore Asahikawa’s famous zoo and sunflower festival. Experience the breathtaking Daisetsuzan National Park before concluding your adventure. From hot springs to scenic vistas, this journey promises unforgettable moments. 


Duration: 9 Days & 8 Nights
Destinations Covered: Sapporo & Asahikawa
inclusions: Transfer from New Chitose Airport to Deluxe Hotel
4 nights stay in Sapporo with breakfast
Jozankei Onsen, Otaru & Shiroi Koibito Park Day Tour, Sapporo
3 nights stay in Asahikawa with breakfast
Asahikawa Sightseeing Tour with Hokuryu Sunflower Village, Hokkaido
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Asahikawa Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of a similar standard.
Extra expenses like visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hokkaido | Transfer to Sapporo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan. After your international flight to Tokyo, take a flight to New Chitose Airport (not included). Upon arrival in Hokkaido, get driven to your hotel in Sapporo and check in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure—stroll through Nakajima Park, unwind at a local sento for a relaxing soak, or visit Yukijirushi Parlour to try Hokkaido’s famous Snow Royal Ice Cream. Enjoy a peaceful evening before your exciting adventures ahead.

items.title: Try Snow Royal Ice Cream at Yukijirushi Parlour
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Sapporo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Begin your half-day sightseeing tour from Sapporo TV Tower and get transfred to the tranquil Hill of the Buddha, a serene retreat blending nature and spirituality. Continue to Sapporo Art Park to explore its creative exhibits before strolling through the scenic Hokkaido University campus. As evening approaches, take a cable car ride to Mt. Moiwa for breathtaking city views. Conclude your day at the lively Tanukikoji Shopping Street before being transfred back to Sapporo TV Tower.

days.title: Day trip to Noboribetsu & Lake Toya
days.desc: Depart from Sapporo TV Tower and get transfred to Shikotsu Toya National Park, starting with Jigokudani (Hell Valley), a surreal volcanic crater with steaming vents. Continue to Oyunuma Pond, known for its bubbling, mineral-rich waters. Then, admire the scenic beauty of Lake Toya, a stunning caldera lake with views of Mount Usu, an active volcano. Conclude with a visit to the Showa Shinzan Lava Dome before getting transfred back to Sapporo TV Tower.

days.title: Day trip to Jozankei, Otaru & Shiroi Koibito Park
days.desc: Head to Sapporo TV Tower to begin your day tour. Get transfred to Jozankei Onsen, a serene hot spring town surrounded by lush mountains. Next, explore Otaru, a picturesque port city known for its beautiful canal, music box museum, and glass workshops. Finally, visit Shiroi Koibito Park, a chocolate-themed attraction famous for its signature white chocolate cookies. After the tour, get transfred back to Sapporo TV Tower.

items.title: Jozankei Onsen, Otaru & Shiroi Koibito Park Day Tour, Sapporo

days.title: Transfer to Asahikawa | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Checkout and get transferred to Sapporo Station for your train to Asahikawa. Upon arrival, get transferred to your hotel and check in. The rest of the day is yours to explore. Stroll through Heiwa Shopping Street, a local favourite for boutique stores and cozy cafés. Visit Tokiwa Park, a peaceful green space with a pond and seasonal flowers. End your day at Asahikawa Design Center, showcasing unique Hokkaido craftsmanship. Relax and soak in the local vibe before your adventures ahead.

days.title: Asahikawa Sightseeing Tour with Hokuryu Sunflower Village
days.desc: Head to Aeon Mall, the start point of your tour. Begin at Asahiyama Zoo, where you can admire penguins, red pandas, and seals. Next, visit Otokoyama Sake Brewery to sample local rice sake and learn about its brewing process. Continue to Hokuryu Sunflower Village, where from late June to August, you can witness vast sunflower fields in full bloom. End the day with a steaming bowl of ramen at Asahikawa Ramen Village before getting transferred back to Aeon Mall.

items.title: Asahikawa Sightseeing Tour with Hokuryu Sunflower Village, Hokkaido

days.title: Day Trip to Furano and Biei
days.desc: Head to Aeon Mall, the start point of your tour. Begin at Patchwork Road in Biei, where rolling hills and a row of larch trees create a stunning landscape. Then, visit Shikisai-no-Oka, a colorful hillside blanketed in vibrant flowers, and savour lavender ice cream. Next, admire the mesmerising blue waters of Shirogane Blue Pond before heading to Shirahige Waterfall, where white streams cascade gracefully into the river. After a day of breathtaking scenery, get transferred back to Aeon Mall.

days.title: Daisetsuzan National Park Tour
days.desc: Head to Aeon Mall, the start point of your tour. Begin with Asahidake, Hokkaido’s tallest mountain, taking the Asahidake Ropeway to witness breathtaking panoramic views of Daisetsuzan National Park. Next, explore the stunning Sounkyo Gorge, where the twin waterfalls, Ginga and Ryusei, cascade down rugged cliffs, creating a mesmerizing sight. End your journey at Sounkyo Onsen, soaking in a traditional Japanese hot spring, the perfect way to unwind before getting transfred back to Aeon Mall.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Check out from your hotel in Asahikawa and get transferred to Asahikawa Airport for your flight back home. Safe travels!
